feeds.name: IEG evaluations and Open Knowledge Repository

stages.name: Extract
stages.detail: API pulls with change detection by last-modified date and checksum; PDFs fetched by document ID.

stages.name: Parse
stages.detail: Layout-aware parsing keeps headings, page numbers and tables. Scanned pages go through OCR with a confidence score.

stages.name: Normalise
stages.detail: Currencies to US$ at award-date rates, dates to ISO, method and category names mapped across policy eras.

stages.name: Resolve
stages.detail: Project IDs, notice numbers, supplier names and sector codes linked into the knowledge graph.

stages.name: Chunk and embed
stages.detail: Section-aware chunks with their heading path; tables stored whole and as rows.

stages.name: Index
stages.detail: Warehouse tables, graph store, and a hybrid keyword + vector index share the same IDs.

stages.name: Validate
stages.detail: Row counts, schema checks, link-score audits and a sample of parsed pages reviewed weekly.
